Textual TUI; owns the asyncio loop.

errors become a banner pointing at the log

p.i:
iterates the chunk stream inside
asyncio.to_thread, pumps Command(resume=…)
after each interrupt. SAME loop both modes —
the chunk shape is identical

the 24 nodes — see
docs/langgraph-topology.mermaid.
Bedrock is reached from HERE, through
langchain-aws ChatBedrockConverse —
schemas stay FLAT, Converse rejects
discriminated unions
